name: AutomationDirect WACSHELF18 enclosure shelf
summary: WACSHELF18 enclosure shelf arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: WACSHELF18 is the drawing identifier for enclosure shelf in AutomationDirect's Enclosure Accessories collection. An enclosure shelf supports the selected equipment inside a compatible enclosure. Its fixing, support and access requirements must be checked against the equipment arrangement.

For example, in a cabinet containing a separately supported auxiliary device, use the WACSHELF18 reference to coordinate shelf fixing, supported equipment and removal route. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/WACSHELF18.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep shelf fixing, supported equipment and removal route visible in the layout.
